verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Mastra publishing quality signals for comparing servers, such as usage counts, health or liveness checks, server scores, or verification badges. Scoring agent runs (mastra-docs-16) and tracking tool usage in your own production runs (mastra-docs-15) are observability and evaluation features, not signals for choosing between servers. They are adjacent features and earn no credit. A framework with an MCP ecosystem could plausibly offer server-curation signals, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compare servers using published quality signals — usage counts, health or liveness checks, scores, or verification badges
